## Purpose
The default silently runs full unrestarted GMRES with single modified Gram-Schmidt (MGS). The Arnoldi basis grew past `memory = 20` (Krylov.jl treats it as a preallocation hint when `restart = false`). Additionally, single MGS accumulated rounding error, stalling or biasing the solve. This PR adds a note on two GMRES flags: `restart = true` and `reorthogonalization`.
